Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [3] Move DataNode packet I/O logging to its own log — identifies “Receiving block,” “Received block,” and “PacketResponder … terminating” as routine INFO-level DataNode communication details that can generate high log volume.

External Knowledge Summary:
- These messages are standard DataNode block-transfer logging at INFO level.
- Similar logs prompted a proposal to use a separate logger so packet I/O verbosity could be controlled independently from other DataNode operations.
